artifact: PHASE 4B §33-§35 - how strict resolution reaches the Phase-4A evaluator without changing expression semantics
mechanism: InputResolver gained an optional `strict: StrictInputResolver`. Every reference node prefers it; when it is absent the legacy fixture path runs unchanged.

mappingRules.RESOLVED: the value is used, with its provenance
mappingRules.MISSING: NEEDS_INPUT, listed as a missing input
mappingRules.NOT_APPROVED: NEEDS_INPUT with its own code, still listed as missing so it is never silently skipped
mappingRules.INCOMPATIBLE: ERROR, because a type conflict is a defect in the supplied data, not a gap

backwardsCompatibility: the Phase-4A runtime suites pass unchanged at this head
